title: HumanAuthorization
description: A human decision recorded against a run. Recording an approval performs no external action in M1-M3; the executor is deferred.

authority.description: Schema 1.3: the authority the decision was taken under. It stays `None` until the operator and public routes set it, and on every earlier record; `None` reads as unspecified, never as operator authority.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied key making retries of the same decision no-ops.

Authority.description: Under whose authority a human decision was recorded (schema 1.3).

oneOf.description: A public visitor deciding on their own simulated run: the record carries no operational authority.
